assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a stunning premium 3D editorial illustration for Rakky Ride, a Lagos ride-hailing app. Portrait 1024x1536 composition. Sophisticated photorealistic CGI, tactile materials, precise beautiful geometry, soft studio daylight, creamy ivory to pale mint seamless background, forest green/emerald hero accents, brushed silver and warm charcoal details. Elegant art direction, not childish, not generic clip art. Large sculptural subject centered in the middle 70% of frame with air around it; bottom 15% gently fades to pale ivory. Consistent visual series. This is artwork ONLY, not an app mockup: absolutely no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no interface, no buttons, no maps. Do not bake a slogan into the artwork; the app will overlay a very short accessible headline separately. Scene: a beautifully designed modern emerald-green compact crossover car in front three-quarter view facing toward the left, realistic sculpted bodywork, silver trim, dark glass and credible tires. A single elegant oversized brushed-metal and green location-pin sculpture rises behind it. Abstract low Lagos-inspired architectural forms and a palm silhouette in the distant background, no roads or map diagrams. Restrained jade gradient halo and sweeping pale mint architectural pedestal, refined cast shadows. The car should be the star, exceptionally polished transport campaign image.
